currency.basis: The brand SVG is served live by the official homepage on 2026-10-04 as the current header logo; this is the design in current use.

identity.basis: The red four-strokes-and-crossbar mark is the UOB brand symbol shown in the header logo of the bank's own official site (uob.com.sg / uobgroup.com) for the Singapore bank (metadata url uob.com.sg, country SG).

assessment.independenceRationale: Observations come from the bank's own official site (header SVG and favicon of the same origin) and are mutually consistent; no third-party source is needed because the official vector asset directly confirms the design and color.

variant.basis: The source red mark matches the accepted icon's composition (four rounded vertical strokes crossed by a horizontal bar, red on transparent); the only difference is the red shade (#f5333f official vs #D03532 accepted), a supported color correction.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All contours, rounded stroke ends, the crossbar and internal transparency survive exactly; the source/final pairs on both themes show no lost or altered details.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole emblem fits the square cell with small even margins on both themes and stays legible at small sizes; strokes and gaps remain distinct; no stretching or clipping.
candidate.rationale: Correction of the UOB mark red to the authoritative official brand color #f5333f taken from the single .cls-1 compound path of the official brand lockup SVG served by the official homepage (fetched 2026-10-04, sha256 139bed79c5409437b22b737603686cebc1fd627796f09cb02208f4b2bec8da39). The accepted icon uses #D03532 (dE76 approx 13.9, clearly visible); geometry is untouched.

proposals.reason: The official UOB group site serves the brand lockup SVG (https://www.uobgroup.com/assets/iwov-resources/assets/BrandAssets/UOB_Logo.svg, fetched 2026-10-04, sha256 139bed79c5409437b22b737603686cebc1fd627796f09cb02208f4b2bec8da39) whose single red path (.cls-1, #f5333f) is the standalone four-strokes-and-crossbar mark identical in geometry to the accepted catalog icon, but in the authoritative current brand red. The accepted icon uses #D03532 (dE76 approx 13.9 vs #f5333f), a clearly visible shade difference; the source is the original vector, so a color-correction replacement is supported.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector (single compound .cls-1 path from the official brand lockup SVG served by the official homepage); correction of the mark red to the authoritative official brand color #f5333f. Geometry untouched; no wordmark text accepted into the standalone mark.

sources.observation: Official UOB group homepage (uob.com.sg redirects here) header references this brand SVG (2619 bytes, viewBox 0 0 214 60, id uob-logo_214x60px_Chinese_UOB_Logo.svg). Its single .cls-1 path (fill #f5333f) is the red UOB mark (four vertical strokes with rounded ends crossed by a horizontal bar); .cls-2 paths (#005cb9) are the wordmark letters. Extracting the red path reproduces the accepted catalog design exactly except for the red shade.

Official favicon is a 16x16 raster of the same red mark (used as visual research evidence only). Its flat red (#FF0000 at 16px) corroborates the red-only mark but is too small to adjudicate the exact shade; the vector brand asset (#f5333f) is authoritative.
